description: The article describes online PSIGanesi simulation for pig tracking in a gas pipeline. It compares calculated travel times for several pig types with field operations and discusses correction of deviations. The provider is Zhang Guoqiang; Li Gang; Han Litao. Coverage: The case is the Shijiazhuang–Xingtai section of the Beijing–Shijiazhuang–Handan pipeline in China. Exact operating dates and simulation intervals were not established. Access: The provider publishes a metadata page describing the resource and its access route. Resource files were not downloaded or executed. Licence and cost: The page does not establish a reuse licence or complete cost conditions. Provider confirmation is required before reuse. Limitations: The public article describes one application. Its numerical results, software versions and transferable accuracy were not independently checked. For simulation it provides a documented pipeline application and a bounded comparison of model outputs with engineering practice. Related resources: For comparison, model-pandapipes provides pipe-network modelling. This is a thematic link, not evidence of use in this study.
